<thought>Search the retrosynthetic template catalog for a retro-Diels-Alder transformation. The forward Diels-Alder forms two C–C sigma bonds (6-6) and converts two C=C double bonds to single bonds, so the bond order changes from double to single (2.0→1.0). I'll query with these bond criteria.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "COC([C@]12CC=CC[C@H]1C(C2)=O)=O",
    "bonds_formed": ["6-6"],
    "bonds_order_changed": ["6-6 (2.0->1.0)"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
